name: Island, north face — juice and shots
prompt: The first reference image is an exact 3D massing model of the café with every fixture labelled; the second is the dimensioned floor plan it was built from. Keep every object exactly where the model puts it, at its size: the island is two parallel counters with an open walkway between them, the espresso machine, grinders, juicer and sink on the back counter, the pastry case and till on the front counter; the back wall is shelving with the menu board centred over a low shelf and a door at the far left, with no counter against it; three open chillers fill the left wall under a lightbox sign; open snack shelving fills the right wall. The third reference is the approved overview render of the same café: match its materials, colours and lighting, and render the view described below from inside that exact space. kōra is a small grab-and-go café in Delhi. The room is a clean rectangle, 32 feet wide and 19 feet deep, with a full-height glass front onto the street and a 12-by-8-foot island bar in the middle. Materials: pale white-oak timber shelving with thin matte-black steel frames, fluted white-oak counter fronts, honed pale-limestone counter tops, warm off-white lime-plaster walls, pale oak-look porcelain plank floor, one deep forest-green accent used only on the fascia, the outdoor chairs and small signs. Signage is black capital letters on white backlit panels. Light is warm white, 3000 K, from LED strips under every shelf and three opal-glass pendants over the island; daylight comes in through the glass front. Everything is tidy and stocked: rows of clear bottles of cold-pressed juice in orange, red, green and gold, fruit cups, kraft snack bags, white coffee cups. No people unless stated, no clutter, no rustic props, no coffee sacks, no exposed brick, no neon, no readable text anywhere except the signs named in the view. A photorealistic interior photograph of the back of the island bar, seen straight on from the pantry aisle. A 12-foot counter in fluted white oak with a pale-limestone top. Below the top, a full-length glass-door under-counter fridge glowing with rows of clear bottles of cold-pressed juice and small wellness shots in gold, red and green. On the counter, a stainless cold-press juicer, a blender, a small sparkling-water tap and a tray of shot glasses. Behind the counter the barista aisle and the back of the front counter, with the glass front and daylight beyond. Warm light from the pendants above, cool light from the fridge. 35mm, chest height, 3:2, natural colour, fine grain.
